eligibility_criteria: 1. A Bachelor’s degree with minimum aggregate of 50%.2. Admission will be done through SRM Joint Entrance Examination for Management (SRMJEEM) followed by a Personal Interview. Students with eligible entrance scores in CAT/XAT/MAT/GMAT/NMAT/CMAT/TANCET will be granted direct consideration for the personal interview.3. Preference would be given to candidates with work experience.
about_program: A 2-year MBA programme at SRM Institute of Science and Technology focused on core management disciplines and leadership capabilities through structured coursework and industry-oriented learning.
career_opportunities: Business Management, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, Strategy
